title: Seat protocol v1: x-openrig.event
description: Data of the extension kind `x-openrig.event`: a hand-off, answer, claim, close, message or prompt seen on the daemon event stream. Only identifiers and a summary: never a message body. By default `summary` is built from fixed metadata (event type and work id); with the gateway's text opt-in (capabilities.features['x-openrig.text']) it is the daemon's own short text, which is sensitive and UNTRUSTED. One line, at most 140 characters. `answer` is part of the vocabulary but the OpenRig event stream carries no authoritative answer marker, so this source emits `close`. A reader that does not know the kind draws it as a generic card (title, summary).

daemonEvent.description: The daemon's RigEvent type this came from, for example queue.handed_off.
